architecture: Shared MEDIA_ORIGINS is imported by discovery and station-list and exported to server CSP. The exact nine-origin list matches TECH. Country resource advances from v8 to v9; connectDomains remains empty and fixed-player CSP stays Radio Paradise-only. No proxy or new arbitrary URL input was introduced.
complexity: The origin/resource change is appropriately small and uses the existing shared policy. Coverage documentation is candid about dated samples and absent host checks. A narrow validation correction and regression cases are sufficient for the finding; no pagination/player redesign is needed.
correctness: Compared src/test changes with DIAL-006 candidate 164ed275bf510869410c1df8fcf42a460510e5e6: production changes are confined to media-policy and country resource URI. Pagination, request-generation guards, player, controller, coordinator, and existing four Meuh/Nova overrides are unchanged. URL parsing strips explicit default HTTPS ports before validation, leaving an approved edge-case requirement unmet.

findings.description: Explicit default HTTPS ports are accepted although approved PRODUCT/TECH require rejecting explicit-port source URLs. new URL('https://streams.radio.co:443/se1a320b47/listen') normalizes port to an empty string before the url.port check, so discovery admits this row and browser validation likewise accepts it. The new negative tests exercise only :8443. This behavior predates this patch but contradicts the exact approved DIAL-007 source admission requirement carried forward for the newly added origins.
findings.requested_change: Reject explicit ports in the original URL authority before URL normalization in both server and browser source validation, preserving exact origin checks. Add regressions for explicit :443 (including both newly admitted origins) as well as the existing nondefault-port cases. If normalized default ports are intentionally allowed, obtain approval for that policy change instead of asserting all explicit ports are rejected.

requirements: Inspected exact candidate (HEAD matches full SHA), Review packet, approved PRODUCT/TECH and their matching SHA-256 hashes. Only the two approved origins were added, with no new UUID override. Dated eight-country candidate table distinguishes direct MP3 evidence from unobserved host playback. One explicit-port rejection requirement is not satisfied; fresh provider/direct and owner host QA remain separate Verify gates.
security: No origin escape, wildcard media access, stream proxy, or new UUID override found. The default-port issue stays on an approved HTTPS origin; it is a literal approved-policy mismatch, not evidence of arbitrary host access. Runtime redirect destinations and CSP/audibility cannot be established by these source checks and remain Verify/owner host obligations.
tests: Inspected new fixture admission/click-UUID/no-override tests, negative URL tests, browser selection tests, exact-origin/CSP/URI tests and retained bounds/stale-response tests. New explicit-port cases use :8443 only and miss :443. Independently ran a Node URL normalization probe, which returned port empty for https://streams.radio.co:443/se1a320b47/listen, and a local discover fixture against existing dist output, which returned status ok and the normalized URL. Source inspection confirms both validators use the same ineffective default-port check. Did not rerun the full suite or fresh live/host probes in Review; the packet's 35-test pass is Implement evidence, with independent execution assigned to Verify.
